statement: Access the hole via Thermeister map in World 5 or teleport; complete a short quest line to unlock it
Opals are the primary resource for progressing in the hole and leveling villagers
Without Opals villagers cannot gain XP
To invest Opals click a villager then choose invest then give Opal
Opal reset is available in Cavern 7 if you make a mistake
Opals may be limited depending on account progression so prioritize carefully
Explorer needs much more XP per level than others so prioritize Opals there
Each Explorer level fills a bar and a new Cavern is discovered
Engineer unlocks schematics giving powerful cavern buffs; some affect outside the cavern
Schematics require ores from the wells and notes from the harp so keep them stocked
Conjurer has three upgrade sections: Hole Magic Village Magic and IdleOn Magic
Hole Magic boosts hole activities: harp notes Bravery monument scaling and extra lamp wishes
Village Magic improves villager XP such as XP per schematic and extra XP per 10 Opals invested; measurement bonuses 1.25x
IdleOn Magic affects outside the hole: 30% all stat boost Forge capacity up to 243x and ballot bonus multipliers
Start Conjurer upgrades in the blue section: blue one two and three for villager XP
Suggested Opal ratio 2:1:1 for Explorer Engineer Conjurer
Well cavern uses buckets to farm gravel gold Redstone mythril and more
You can remove Rock layers in the well to access new resources
Prioritize bucket fill rate more buckets and bar expandorama upgrades for efficiency
Resources collected in the well can be traded for Opals
Motherlode: break layers with mining efficiency for one opal per layer; efficiency requirement rises but opal reward stays constant
Motherload and bucket synergy bonus boosts bucket fill rate based on layers destroyed; very strong
Dawg Den is a stat check minigame testing accuracy defense damage; each score threshold earns an opal
Amplifiers increase base multiplier so score targets are reached faster
Too many mobs on screen max the furom meter and end your run
You can attempt Dawg Den unlimited times like Coliseum
Monument is an AFK area where each AFK hour increases reward multiplier
Monument battle is text-based using sword damage and dice rolls; start with three swords rising to five after 80 hours AFK
After each round select an upgrade such as bucket fill rate mining efficiency or villager XP
Losing the battle loses all your bonuses
Worth building AFK hours for higher reward multiplier and sword damage
After a battle you are locked out 24 hours not tied to daily reset
Bell cavern: spend money to increase hourly ring rate by 2% per purchase; four bell types
Ringing the bell adds plus one each hour granting random boosts like harp note gains bucket fill rate or villager XP
Pinging the bell is 10 an hour and each ping gives an opal
Cleaning the bell is 10 an hour with 60% chance to unlock new improvements
Renewing the bell is a prestige resetting upgrade costs while pursuing improvement methods and earned opals
At 100% heart power you can strum strings by clicking and dragging; each strum permanently levels strings
C strings give notes used as currency; E strings give chance for an opal; unlock more strings and notes
Ancient's Echo pack includes attire giving 2x damage as true multiplier 30% AFK gain and 1.5x villager XP
Rates Ancient's Echo pack top of A or low S; godly but not close to Autoloot or Sacred Methods
Genie's Lamp uses charges to unlock wishes or reset Opals or Conjurer points
Charges are slow so start by unlocking new wishes
Taker of Measurements villager is incredibly busted with insane upgrades
Hold one opal to get Taker of Measurements gaining XP; he is unlocked in Cavern 7
Cleaning the bell gives god-tier improvements raising bell generation from 200 to 2200 an hour
Improvement Stacking engineer schematic upgrade is very strong but requires notes
Run a lot of C notes to get currency to unlock new notes
New Monument unlock lets you rethrow five swords per story reducing RNG
Battle upgrade priority: Bravery Opal Percent Opals Villager XP Bucket Fill Rate Mining Efficiency
Explanations given will take you weeks in advance; free-to-play players can get far in decent time
Gem shop Conjurer points are super strong and an extra opal purchasable per day helps paying players
